confluenceBaseUrl.description: Base URL for Confluence, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki.

spaceKey.description: Confluence space key where the page will be created/updated.

pageId.description: Existing page ID. If provided, Confluence-Agent performs an update.

parentPageId.description: Optional parent page ID for new pages.

labels.description: Optional labels to apply to the page.

dryRun.description: When true, build preview/output only and do not call Confluence.
